title: Functional assays with human patient-derived enteroid monolayers to assess the human gut barrier
protocol: Prepare the Human monolayer EDM media required for differentiating stem cells into colon specific cells.
Incubate the EDM media at room temperature (20°C–22°C) during preparation.
Keep the EDM media at 4°C for up to 2-3 days if not used immediately.
Ensure the human monolayer media is fresh and constituted on the day of EDMs preparation.
Prepare Matrigel solution diluted in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) at a ratio of 1:40 on ice.
Coat each transwell with 50 μL of the PBS-diluted Matrigel.
Leave the plate at room temperature around 20°C–22°C during monolayer preparation for 60–90 min.
Remove media from organoid culture in a 12-well plate.
Add 1 mL of 0.5 μM PBS-EDTA to each well.
Scrape cells/Matrigel in the PBS-EDTA mixture and collect the cell suspension in a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 200 xg for 4 min to precipitate the cell pellets.
Remove the supernatant above the pellets.
Add 300 μL of TrypLE per well to separate the cells from each other.
Incubate the TrypLE suspension in a 37°C water bath for 5–15 min.
Disrupt the organoids mechanically by pipetting up and down up to 20 times using a p1000 micropipette until no cell clumps/aggregates appear.
Inactivate the TrypLE by adding serum-containing buffer at a ratio of 1:5 (1 TrypLE: 5 washing media).
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 4 min to remove TrypLE and precipitate the dissociated cells.
Place a 70 μm filter over a 50 mL tube.
Wet the filter with 200 μL human monolayer media.
Resuspend cells in human monolayer media to achieve a good concentration of cells.
Filter the suspended cells using the pre-wet 70 μm filter over a 50 mL tube.
Count single cells or very small clusters of cells using the Trypan blue method or automated counter.
Coat 96-well trans-well plates with Matrigel.
Plate stem cells in the coated wells.
Change media on day one.
Measure TEER by REMS AutoSampler and start experiment on day two.
Calculate number of cells needed for seeding (8 × 10^4 cells per transwell).
Prepare cell suspension mix in appropriate volume.
Aspirate PBS from Matrigel coating without touching bottom of the well.
Add 250 μl of monolayer media to basolateral side of transwell.
Add 100 μl of cell suspension mix to apical side of each well.
Incubate plate on a flat surface inside the hood for approximately 15 minutes.
Transfer plate carefully to incubator on a flat shelf.
Change the media from the apical and basolateral sides of the transwells using monolayer media.
Check the monolayer appearance under the microscope.
Measure the transepithelial electrical resistance (TEER) using the REMS automated TEER machine after 24 hours.
Keep human monolayer media at around 20°C–22°C before changing the media.
Add media smoothly and slowly on the apical side of the transwells to avoid cell detachment.
Measure the TEER using the REMS automated TEER machine in the morning.
Expose the basolateral side of the transwells to e-cigarette vapor-infused media for 4 hours.
Collect supernatants from the basolateral side at 4 hours post-exposure to assess inflammatory cytokines.
Collect supernatant from the apical part of the transwells and store it at -20°C until analysis.
Add RNA lysis buffer to the cells attached to the transwells.
Incubate the lysis buffer with the transwell for 2-3 minutes.
Pipette the lysis buffer up and down 10 times.
Collect the cell lysate in 1.5 Eppendorf tubes for further RNA extraction.
Expose EDMs on Day 3 of preparation continuously to e-cigarette vapor-infused media for 4 h.
Refresh medium with new e-cigarette vapor-infused media for repeated exposure (3 times).
Measure TEER after 24 h of exposure.
Collect supernatants from the basolateral side of transwells at 24 h for cytokine assay.
Collect cell lysate for RNA extraction.
Aliquot fresh RNA into two parts after extraction and concentration measurement.
Use 200–300 ng of RNA for RNA sequencing.
Use 500 ng–1000 ng of RNA for transcriptome analysis by qRT-PCR.
Avoid repeated freezing and thawing of extracted RNA.
Place the plate on the REMS plate holder and ensure all four corners are properly placed and clipped in.
Select the option “Take Data/Well Sequence” tab in REMS software.
Perform 70% Ethanol Rinse using Wash Station 1: Right.
Perform Wash Media Rinse using Wash Station 2: Left.
Select “Stabilize” to confirm that the Recording Electrode is working correctly.
Calibrate test of A1 Well using WPI REMS-96C recording electrode.
Under Movement tab, send electrode to well A1 position using XY Position Axis.
Adjust Z Low to 130 mm.
Ensure basal Electrode is centered (adjust XY as needed).
Send Z Low down 2 mm at a time to confirm basal electrode calibration.
Close the Plate File Settings without saving adjustments.
Return to “Take Data/ Well Sequence” tab.
Set the TEER Electrode Sequence by checking the increment box and filling in the number 1.
Go to the plate map to select targeted wells.
Set the desired sequence for TEER measurements.
Label the experiment name.
Select “Start” under “Take Data/ Well Sequence” tab.
TEER values will be saved in a Text File.
Plate cells in 24-well transwell inserts on Day 0 for the human monolayer EDMs preparation.
Change media on Day 1 of the Gentamicin protection assay.
Infect the EDMs with E.coli for 1-3 hours then add gentamicin to kill extracellular bacteria on Day 2.
Lyse the cells and prepare the bacteria dilutions and plate after adding gentamicin.
Count the bacteria and replate the dilutions if needed on Day 3.
Inoculate one loopful of bacteria from an agar plate into 10 mL of LB in a 50 mL conical tube with a slightly loose lid.
Incubate the culture at 37°C in an orbital shaker at 150 rpm for 6–8 hours.
Add 100 μL of the day culture to 10 mL of LB in a 15 mL conical tube.
Incubate overnight without shaking at 37°C with a tightly closed lid.
Measure the OD600 of E. coli LF-82 bacteria using a spectrophotometer.
Spin down the calculated concentration of bacteria for 2 minutes at 9391 xg.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the bacteria in 1 mL of wash media without antibiotics.
Infect monolayers with E. coli LF-82 at an MOI of 1:30 in wash buffer without antibiotics.
Add 200 μL of the bacterial mixture to the apical side of each transwell.
Add 200 μg/mL gentamicin to kill extracellular bacteria after 1-3 hours of infection.
Incubate the media for 90 minutes in a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator with gentamicin.
Remove the media from the wells used for bacterial internalization at each time point.
Add 150 μL of 1% Triton X-100 to the apical side of each transwell and incubate for 10 minutes in a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator.
Pipette up and down 5-7 times to lyse cells.
Do serial dilution of cell lysate by adding 100 μL of lysate to 900 μL of 1× PBS (10−1 dilution).
Plate 50 μL of 10−6, 10−5, 10−4, 10−3, 10−2, and 10−1 dilutions on LB agar tri-plates.
Incubate the plates upside-down in a 37°C incubator for 16–18 hours.
Remove 200 μg/mL gentamicin after 90 minutes for longer infection time points.
Add 200 μL of low gentamicin (50 μg/ml) to the apical side of the wells till the end of the experiment.
Count colony-forming units (CFUs) from different dilutions on the next day and calculate average total CFUs.
